metadata.notes: Baseline architecture snapshot. All signatures reflect commit 7867d6c5. This is the upstream vLLM repo; the vllm-ascend-specific patch/ directory does not exist here, so patch_catalog is empty by design. ascend_implementations fields record the known vllm-ascend override class names for cross-project impact analysis.

project_overview.what: vLLM is a high-throughput, low-latency LLM inference and serving engine. It provides offline batch inference (LLM class), an OpenAI/Anthropic/Cohere-compatible HTTP server, and a pluggable execution core spanning multiple hardware platforms (CUDA, ROCm, XPU, CPU, TPU, and out-of-tree platforms such as Ascend NPU).
project_overview.problem: Serving large transformer/MoE/multimodal models efficiently requires (1) paged attention over a shared KV cache, (2) continuous batching with prefix caching and preemption, (3) graph capture / torch.compile for kernel launch overhead, (4) tensor/pipeline/data/expert parallelism, (5) speculative decoding and structured outputs, while remaining portable across accelerators.
project_overview.architecture_style: Layered, plugin-based. A stable hardware-agnostic core (V1 engine: Scheduler -> Executor -> Worker -> ModelRunner -> AttentionBackend) is separated from hardware-specific implementation via the Platform abstraction and entry-point plugins. vllm-ascend injects NPU support through a Platform subclass plus monkey-patches and subclassed Worker/ModelRunner/Attention/Communicator.
top_level_layout: vllm/v1/core/ - scheduler, KV cache manager, block pool
vllm/model_executor/ - model registry, layers (attention/moe/quant/rope), custom ops
vllm/multimodal/, vllm/parser/, vllm/reasoning/, vllm/tool_parsers/, vllm/tokenizers/, vllm/renderers/

core_modules.name: Platform abstraction (vllm/platforms)
core_modules.responsibility: Select and expose the active hardware platform; provide the single extension point where OOT hardware injects worker class, attention backend selection, communicator, punica wrapper, graph wrapper, distributed PG init, config defaults, and capability queries.
core_modules.implementation_principle: current_platform is resolved lazily via module-level __getattr__ to avoid resolving during import (so OOT plugins can import Platform first). resolve_current_platform_cls_qualname() first honors an explicit VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu, then loads entry points in group 'vllm.platform_plugins', iterates builtin detectors (tpu/cuda/rocm/xpu/cpu) plus OOT plugins, and requires exactly one activated OOT plugin (OOT wins over builtin). Each detector returns a fully-qualified class name or None. The chosen class is imported and instantiated once and cached. Platform subclass overrides classmethods; there is NO get_worker_cls hook - worker class is set as a side effect of check_and_update_config by assigning parallel_config.worker_cls.

core_modules.name: Configuration (vllm/config)
core_modules.responsibility: Centralized typed configuration. VllmConfig aggregates ModelConfig, CacheConfig, ParallelConfig, SchedulerConfig, CompilationConfig, etc. All configs are pydantic dataclasses created via @config (extra='forbid'), each having compute_hash().
core_modules.implementation_principle: ModelConfig loads the HF config in __post_init__, resolves architecture/runner/dtype/max length/multimodal. ParallelConfig derives world_size = pp*tp*pcp (*(dp for external_launcher)) in __post_init__. VllmConfig.__post_init__ performs large validation/normalization and calls current_platform.config hooks. Hashes are recursive SHA-256 over normalized fields and feed the compilation cache key.

core_modules.name: Engine core & scheduling (vllm/v1/engine, vllm/v1/core)
core_modules.responsibility: Run the continuous-batching loop: admit requests, schedule token budgets and KV blocks, dispatch a model step, collect sampled tokens, update request state, and emit outputs.
core_modules.implementation_principle: EngineCore.step(): (1) Scheduler.schedule() picks running + waiting requests under a token budget and allocates KV via KVCacheManager/KVCacheCoordinator; on OOM it preempts lowest priority. (2) model_executor.execute_model(scheduler_output, non_block=True) returns a Future. (3) Scheduler.get_grammar_bitmask() computes structured-output bitmasks concurrently with the forward. (4) future.result(); if None, model_executor.sample_tokens(grammar_output) is called (deferred sampling). (5) Scheduler.update_from_output() advances tokens, detects stops, frees/preempts, returns EngineCoreOutputs. step_with_batch_queue pipeline-overlaps scheduling with execution when max_concurrent_batches>1. EngineCoreProc runs EngineCore in a separate process with ZMQ input/output socket threads; run_busy_loop cycles _process_input_queue -> _process_engine_step.

core_modules.name: KV cache (vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_manager.py, block_pool.py, kv_cache_utils.py)
core_modules.responsibility: Paged KV cache allocation, prefix caching, block hashing, and eviction.
core_modules.implementation_principle: BlockPool owns a list of KVCacheBlock and a FreeKVCacheBlockQueue (LRU). KVCacheManager maps requests to block tables, does longest-prefix-match via get_computed_blocks(), allocates slots per step, caches full blocks under block hashes, and frees on finish. KVCacheCoordinator (per attention type / hybrid layouts) unifies page sizes across FullAttentionSpec, MLAAttentionSpec, MambaSpec, and custom specs. resolve_kv_cache_block_sizes + Platform.update_block_size_for_backend reconcile manager block size with kernel block sizes.

core_modules.name: Executors (vllm/v1/executor)
core_modules.responsibility: Dispatch execute_model/sample_tokens/collective_rpc to one or many workers.
core_modules.implementation_principle: Executor ABC chooses implementation via Executor.get_class(): 'uni' -> UniProcExecutor (in-process WorkerWrapperBase), 'mp' -> MultiprocExecutor (ZMQ broadcast MQ + response MQs, one WorkerProc per rank), 'ray' -> RayDistributedExecutor/ RayExecutorV2 (compiled DAG). Base execute_model delegates to collective_rpc('execute_model'). Supports non_block futures for async scheduling and PP.

core_modules.name: Worker & ModelRunner (vllm/v1/worker)
core_modules.responsibility: Own a device, load the model, allocate KV cache, run the forward+sample loop, capture CUDA graphs, and exchange intermediate tensors for PP.
core_modules.implementation_principle: WorkerBase defines lifecycle: init_device, load_model, determine_available_memory (profile_run), initialize_from_config (initialize_kv_cache), compile_or_warm_up_model (kernel_warmup + capture_model), execute_model, sample_tokens. WorkerWrapperBase lazily imports the class named by parallel_config.worker_cls and optionally dynamically injects worker_extension_cls into __bases__. GPUModelRunner (V1) composes LoRA/KV-connector/EC-connector mixins, builds attention metadata per AttentionGroup, runs encoder, model forward, logits (model.compute_logits), then sampling. A V2 runner exists under vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py selected by use_v2_model_runner.

core_modules.name: Attention backend abstraction (vllm/v1/attention)
core_modules.responsibility: Define and select pluggable attention implementations (FlashAttention, Triton, MLA, FlashInfer, ROCm AITER, sparse, etc.) with capability negotiation.
core_modules.implementation_principle: AttentionBackend ABC has exactly three abstract static methods (get_name, get_impl_cls, get_builder_cls); everything else is a concrete capability hook (supports_dtype, supports_head_size, supports_block_size, supports_combination, validate_configuration, is_mla, is_sparse, get_supported_kernel_block_sizes, customize_spec, supported_kv_cache_layouts, is_ssm). Registration: register_backend() populates AttentionBackendEnum overrides. Selection: Attention.__init__ -> selector.get_attn_backend() -> @cache _cached_get_attn_backend() -> current_platform.get_attn_backend_cls(selected_backend, attn_selector_config, num_heads). Explicit backend is validated via validate_configuration; otherwise platform ranks candidates by capability. Metadata is built per step by AttentionMetadataBuilder.build()/build_for_cudagraph_capture() into a per-layer dict installed via set_forward_context.

core_modules.name: Model executor & registry (vllm/model_executor)
core_modules.responsibility: Register and lazily resolve model architectures, provide layers (attention, MoE, quantization, rotary, pooler), custom ops, and weight loaders.
core_modules.implementation_principle: ModelRegistry maps architecture names to lazy module:class loaders via register_model(); resolve_model_cls() normalizes architecture, tries native implementations, transformers-backed implementations, and convert_type fallbacks. CustomOp/PluggableLayer allow OOT replacement of layer classes through op_registry_oot keyed by class name; forward dispatch selects forward_cuda/forward_hip/forward_xpu/forward_cpu/forward_native/forward_oot based on current_platform.

core_modules.name: Quantization (vllm/model_executor/layers/quantization)
core_modules.responsibility: Support weight/activation quantization schemes (fp8, awq, gptq, compressed-tensors, modelopt, mxfp4/nvfp4/mxfp8, quark, inc, torchao, humming, etc.) via a QuantizationConfig factory.
core_modules.implementation_principle: get_quant_config() resolves the config based on model_config.quantization, verifies platform support, and methods create_weights/apply/process_weights_after_loading. Platform.supported_quantization gates which schemes are allowed. OOT platforms register their own quantization configs in pre_register_and_update.

core_modules.name: Compilation (vllm/compilation)
core_modules.responsibility: Apply torch.compile / CUDA graph capture to reduce kernel-launch overhead, with piecewise graph splitting and a custom pass manager.
core_modules.implementation_principle: Pipeline: torch.compile -> CompilationConfig.init_backend() returns a VllmBackend for VLLM_COMPILE mode -> VllmBackend wraps a CompilerManager -> make_compiler() selects a CompilerInterface (InductorStandaloneAdaptor / InductorAdaptor / EagerAdaptor / platform backend) -> split_graph partitions at splitting_ops -> PiecewiseBackend compiles each Range -> wrap_with_cudagraph_if_needed wraps each piece in current_platform.get_static_graph_wrapper_cls() (default CUDAGraphWrapper) at runtime_mode=PIECEWISE. PostGradPassManager (a torch CustomGraphPass) is installed at current_platform.pass_key and runs InductorPass instances. Caching keyed by VllmConfig.compute_hash().

core_modules.name: Distributed (vllm/distributed)
core_modules.responsibility: Initialize torch distributed and model-parallel groups; provide collective ops and device-specific communicators.
core_modules.implementation_principle: parallel_state defines GroupCoordinator wrapping ProcessGroups for world/tp/etp/pp/dp/ep/pcp/dcp/eplb, plus custom vllm.ops all_reduce/reduce_scatter/all_gather. initialize_model_parallel lays out groups in order ExternalDP x DP x PP x PCP x TP. Device communicators (base_device_communicator.DeviceCommunicatorBase, CudaCommunicator, CpuCommunicator, XpuCommunicator) implement all_reduce/all_gather/reduce_scatter and custom (e.g. custom allreduce) paths; All2AllManagerBase handles MoE dispatch/combine.

core_modules.name: Sampling (vllm/v1/sample)
core_modules.responsibility: Convert logits to token ids with temperature/top-k/top-p/penalties/logits-processors and speculative rejection sampling.
core_modules.implementation_principle: Sampler.forward applies logits processors and penalties, then TopKTopPSampler dispatches to forward_cuda/forward_hip/forward_xpu/forward_cpu/native per platform. RejectionSampler implements speculative rejection sampling (draft probs vs target probs) with Triton kernels.

core_modules.name: Entrypoints (vllm/entrypoints)
core_modules.responsibility: Expose offline LLM API and HTTP servers compatible with OpenAI/Anthropic/Cohere, plus CLI and launchers.
core_modules.implementation_principle: FastAPI routers per endpoint family; app_state holds the engine client; AsyncLLM wraps EngineCoreClient for asyncio. Protocol models define request/response schemas. Plugin entry point group vllm.endpoint_plugins allows OOT endpoint injection.

implementation_principles.engine_core_scheduling_loop: EngineCoreProc.run_busy_loop repeatedly: _process_input_queue (dispatch ADD/ABORT/UTILITY from ZMQ) -> _process_engine_step. EngineCore.step() calls Scheduler.schedule() to build SchedulerOutput, then Executor.execute_model(scheduler_output, non_block=True) returns a future, computes grammar bitmask concurrently, joins the future (or calls sample_tokens if execute_model returned None), processes aborts, and calls Scheduler.update_from_output() to build EngineCoreOutputs. Outputs are serialized (msgpack) and pushed over ZMQ to the client; the frontend OutputProcessor detokenizes into RequestOutput. AsyncScheduler uses output placeholders to schedule the next step before prior samples are known.
implementation_principles.gpu_model_runner_forward: GPUModelRunner.execute_model(scheduler_output, intermediate_tensors): (1) _update_states syncs request state from scheduler output; (2) _prepare_inputs builds input_ids/positions and computes num_scheduled_tokens; (3) _build_attention_metadata builds CommonAttentionMetadata and per-AttentionGroup metadata via builder.build/build_for_cudagraph_capture; (4) encoder (multimodal) runs if applicable; (5) set_forward_context installs attn metadata, then model forward; (6) hidden_states[logits_indices] -> self.model.compute_logits; (7) sampling (Sampler) or deferral to sample_tokens. Overridable seams: _prepare_inputs, _model_forward, _build_attention_metadata, initialize_attn_backend/kv_cache, _compute logits path, _sample.
implementation_principles.platform_plugin_loading: vllm.platforms uses a module-level __getattr__ to lazily resolve current_platform on first access. resolve_current_platform_cls_qualname() loads entry points under 'vllm.platform_plugins' via load_plugins_by_group, evaluates builtin detectors plus OOT detectors, requires exactly one OOT activation (which takes precedence), else exactly one builtin, else UnspecifiedPlatform. A detector is a zero-arg callable returning a qualname or None. vllm-ascend exposes NPUPlatform through this entry point.
implementation_principles.attention_backend_registration_and_selec: register_backend() stores class-path overrides keyed by AttentionBackendEnum. At layer construction, Attention.__init__ calls selector.get_attn_backend(...) which builds AttentionSelectorConfig and calls @cache _cached_get_attn_backend -> current_platform.get_attn_backend_cls(selected_backend, config, num_heads). Explicit user backend is validated through AttentionBackend.validate_configuration; otherwise the platform returns its preferred class (CUDA/ROCm/XPU/NPU each rank candidates). The runner then regroups layers into AttentionGroups and instantiates builders via get_builder_cls().
implementation_principles.torch_compile_integration: For CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE, torch.compile uses VllmBackend as backend. VllmBackend builds a CompilerManager -> make_compiler picks CompilerInterface (InductorStandaloneAdaptor/InductorAdaptor/EagerAdaptor/platform). The FX graph is split at splitting_ops; each piece becomes a PiecewiseBackend compiled per Range. Pieces are optionally wrapped by the platform static graph wrapper (CUDAGraphWrapper default, torchair for NPU) at runtime_mode PIECEWISE. PostGradPassManager (CustomGraphPass) applies InductorPass fusion passes. Cache key = VllmConfig.compute_hash().
implementation_principles.kv_cache_management: CacheConfig.block_size is reconciled with attention kernel block sizes by Platform.update_block_size_for_backend (LCM across backends, hybrid/mamba page padding, quantized skip-layer alignment). The runner asks Worker get_kv_cache_spec, the engine resolves a KVCacheConfig, and KVCacheManager allocates blocks per request each step from BlockPool (FreeKVCacheBlockQueue LRU + block-hash prefix cache). Attention backends consume block tables/slot mappings via CommonAttentionMetadata and bind allocated tensors with AttentionLayerBase.bind_kv_cache.

vllm/model_executor/models/vision.py (except FusedInputNorm)
Only the FusedInputNorm.forward shim is relevant; other vision changes are GPU-generic and not on the NPU override path.

patch_catalog.note: This is the upstream vllm-project/vllm repository at commit 7867d6c5. There is no vllm/patch/ directory (patch/ exists only in vllm-ascend). Therefore no patch catalog can be extracted from this snapshot. vllm-ascend patches target the definitely_affected_paths listed above and are documented in vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py in the vllm-ascend repo.

steps: 在 vllm/model_executor/models/ 下创建模型文件
在 vllm/model_executor/models/registry.py 中注册
在 vllm/config/model.py 中添加架构默认值（如需要）
添加测试：tests/models/
在 vllm/config/ 对应配置类中添加字段（使用 @dataclass + config 元数据）
在 vllm/engine/arg_utils.py 中添加 CLI 参数（映射到配置字段）
添加测试
在 vllm/platforms/ 中创建新的 Platform 子类
通过 vllm.platform_plugins entry point 注册
实现平台特定的 attention、worker、通信等
在 vllm_ascend/patch/platform/ 中创建 patch 文件
实现 monkey-patch 逻辑（修改上游 vLLM 的类/函数）
在 vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py 中添加文档（what/why/how/related PR/future plan）
Patch 会被 adapt_patch(is_global_patch=True) 自动发现和加载
在 vllm_ascend/patch/worker/ 中创建 patch 文件
实现 monkey-patch 逻辑
在 vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py 中添加文档（同上）
Patch 会被 adapt_patch(is_global_patch=False) 自动发现和加载
评估是否需要 patch：attention 替换 → worker patch；修改 forward → worker patch；结构差异大 → 在 vllm_ascend/models/ 中创建 NPU 特有实现
添加 worker patch（如 patch_<model_name>.py）
在 vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py 中记录
添加测试：tests/e2e/models/
在 vllm_ascend/envs.py 的 env_variables 字典中添加
命名遵循 VLLM_ASCEND_* 规范
添加文档注释（默认值、有效范围、是否敏感）
在代码中通过 from vllm_ascend import envs 引用，禁止硬编码环境变量名
在 vllm_ascend/attention/ 中创建新的 attention 实现
继承 vllm_ascend/attention/abstract.py 中的基类
在 vllm_ascend/attention/__init__.py 中注册

vllm.environment_setup: cd ~/code/vllm && source .venv/bin/activate && uv pip install -r requirements/test/cuda.txt
